Ethan Price 104 is a Senior Tech Lead at EcomVista Ltd., where I collaborated with him on several cross-functional projects. His ability to balance technical rigor with team dynamics makes him a standout colleague.  

Ethan’s expertise in microservices architecture is evident in the scalable platform he designed for EcomVista’s inventory management system. Over three years, he refactored monolithic components into modular services, reducing deployment times by 40% and improving system resilience. He also mentored junior engineers, ensuring best practices were embedded in the team’s workflow.  

Soft skills are equally strong. Ethan excels at translating technical decisions into business value, which was critical during a recent stakeholder meeting. When disagreements arose about prioritizing features, he facilitated a data-driven discussion that aligned engineering and product goals. His clarity and patience prevented delays.  

His Agile leadership reshaped our team’s approach to sprint planning. By introducing lightweight, outcome-focused ceremonies, he cut cycle times by 25% without sacrificing quality. Beyond his own work, Ethan consistently advocates for cross-team collaboration, often bridging gaps between dev and ops to resolve bottlenecks.  

Ethan’s combination of technical depth, communication clarity, and collaborative mindset has been a consistent asset. He’s a reliable, self-motivated professional who thrives in dynamic environments. I’d recommend him without hesitation for any role requiring both technical precision and team-oriented problem-solving.
